blocks.text:
By deriving directly from `Gtk::Widget` you can
        do all the drawing for your widget directly, instead of just arranging
        child widgets. For instance, a `Gtk::Label` draws
        the text of the label, but does not do this by using other
        widgets.
blocks.zh: 通过从Gtk::Widget派生部件你可以为部件绘制所有的图形，而不仅仅是排列子部件。例如：Gtk::Label不需要使用其他部件即可绘制标签文本。

blocks.text:
When deriving from `Gtk::Widget`, you should
        override the following virtual methods. The methods marked (optional)
        need not be overridden in all custom widgets. The base class's methods
        may be appropriate.
    
      get_request_mode_vfunc(): (optional) Return what `Gtk::SizeRequestMode` is preferred by the widget.
      measure_vfunc(): Calculate the minimum and natural width or height of the widget.
      size_allocate_vfunc(): (optional) Position the widget, given the height and width that it has actually been given.
      on_realize():  (optional)
      on_unrealize(): (optional)
      on_map(): (optional)
      on_unmap(): (optional)
      snapshot_vfunc(): Create a render node, e.g. a `Cairo::Context` node, and draw on it.
get_request_mode_vfunc(): (optional) Return what `Gtk::SizeRequestMode` is preferred by the widget.
blocks.zh: get_request_mode_vfunc()：覆写此虚函数是可选的，返回此部件的Gtk::SizeRequestMode偏好。

blocks.text: measure_vfunc(): Calculate the minimum and natural width or height of the widget.
blocks.zh: measure_vfunc()：计算此部件的最小自然高度或宽度。

blocks.text: size_allocate_vfunc(): (optional) Position the widget, given the height and width that it has actually been given.
blocks.zh: on_size_allocate()：提供将实际给予部件的宽度和高度以定位部件。
on_map()：覆写此虚函数是可选的。
on_unmap()：覆写此虚函数是可选的。
on_map()：覆写此虚函数是可选的。
on_unmap()：覆写此虚函数是可选的。

blocks.text: snapshot_vfunc(): Create a render node, e.g. a `Cairo::Context` node, and draw on it.
blocks.zh: snapshot_vfunc()：创建一个渲染节点（例如：一个Cairo::Context节点），并在其上进行绘制。

blocks.text:
The first 3 methods in the previous table are also overridden in custom
        containers. They are briefly described in the
        [Custom Containers]() section.
blocks.zh: 上述前三个函数在自定义容器中也被覆写。它们在自定义容器小节做了简要说明。

blocks.text: Class Init and Instance Init Functions

Some `GTK` functions, if called at all, must be
called from the class init function. Some other `GTK`
functions, if called, must be called from the instance init function.
If your custom widget must call any of those functions, you can derive a class
from `Glib::ExtraClassInit` and derive your custom class
from that class. The [custom CSS name example]()
shows how that's done.
blocks.zh: 一些GTK函数必须在类的init函数中才能调用。另一些GTK函数必须在实例的init函数中才能调用。如果你的自定义部件必须调用这些函数中的任意一个，那么你可以从Glib::ExtraClassInit派生一个类，并从该类派生你的自定义类。以下示例演示了如何完成这些操作。
